subject.title: fix: keep yielded parent runs deferred until subagents settle

question: After the correctness blockers are repaired, should yielded-parent waiting become a permanent public `deferred` cron, protocol, and Plugin SDK status?
rationale: The internal lifecycle bug can be fixed without expanding the public status contract, while adopting `deferred` creates long-term compatibility obligations for persisted data and downstream consumers that tests alone cannot authorize.

options.title: Keep Waiting Internal
options.body: Preserve existing public status values and use yielded-waiting only inside runtime lifecycle and reconciliation code.

options.title: Approve Public Deferred
options.body: Retain the new public status only after explicit fresh-install, upgrade, persistence, and downstream-consumer compatibility proof.

recommendation.title: Keep Waiting Internal
recommendation.body: Preserve existing public status values and use yielded-waiting only inside runtime lifecycle and reconciliation code.
